packs.title: Icons & Waterways
packs.promise: Meet the missions, river, gardens and gathering places that shape San Antonio.

q.s: Let a short movement redraw the same river.
st: Use the official River Bend accessibility map to choose an open approach near Commerce Street.
Walk a comfortable short stretch, then stop at a second permitted viewpoint of the same bend.
Describe one thing that moved into view and one that disappeared; keep away from the water edge while writing.

q.s: Notice how a food description makes you curious.
st: Browse a displayed menu in the open Market Square area without blocking customers.
Choose three words that describe ingredients or preparation, and note one dish they belong to.
Write a question you would ask before ordering; a purchase or conversation is optional.

q.s: Make room for what a single building cannot explain.
st: Begin with an open NPS visitor exhibit or the official Mission San José page.
Read one explanation of life at the mission, then observe a permitted courtyard or building view.
Make a two-panel note: one sourced fact with its source, and one question the place leaves you with. Do not invent the words of people who lived here.

packs.title: River Walk and Old Plazas
packs.promise: Trace the river’s curves and the older city just above them.

q.s: Record one way the map helps explain a space that buildings or works partly hide.
st: Follow the current open visitor route and find a site map or public interpretive panel.
Locate two places it identifies and compare their positions with what you can see.
Record one way the map helps explain a space that buildings or works partly hide.

q.s: Arrange them into a postcard-size drawing without adding shop names.
st: Use an open dry walkway with a view of the lagoon.
Pick three shapes: the water outline, a building edge and a bridge or walkway.
Arrange them into a postcard-size drawing without adding shop names.

q.t: The City from a Lower Seat
q.s: After disembarking, describe one bridge from below and one place you recognized from your earlier walk.
st: Check GO RIO’s live dock directions and choose an operating narrated cruise.
Board with a ticket and follow crew instructions throughout the ride.
After disembarking, describe one bridge from below and one place you recognized from your earlier walk.
